title: How To Clean Stairs Carpet Without Ruining Your Subfloor (The DIY Reality Check)
description:
Cleaning carpet on stairs is physically exhausting and mechanically dangerous if you use the wrong equipment. A standard residential stair tread is only 9 to 11 inches deep, making 10-12" upright extractors unstable. In this comprehensive guide, carpet forensic experts and installers break down the exact top-to-bottom extraction protocol, why unrinsed shampoos cause rapid re-soiling on the bullnose, and when DIY over-wetting leads to tack strip rust and SBR latex delamination.
